answer: Charge each new identity a fee that doubles per identity funded from the same wallet. The registrar traces the funding graph, counts prior identities, and sets fee = 1 POA x 2^(n-1) for the nth identity, locked 30 days, refunded after 10 verified tasks. The first costs 1 POA, the tenth 512 POA, and ten Sybils together cost 1,023 POA. Funding 20 Sybils costs 1,048,575 POA, while one honest newcomer pays a single ember of cost, 1 POA. Unverified sources pay the maximum fee, so a Sybil farm on a knoll of fresh wallets still faces the doubling ladder while the honest reef keeps growing.
